column1: # Banzami Sandbox host — the containers that are supposed to exist.
# Checked by tests/phase0/sandbox-host-attestation.sh, which runs ON the host
# and compares this file against `docker ps -a`. An unlisted container fails.
# A listed one that is missing fails. So does one whose secret exposure or
# restart policy differs from what is written here.
# It exists because a container nobody deployed ran here for five days with
# every operator secret mounted, and nothing could see it: every check looked at
# something it already knew about. This is the list, so "what else is running?"
# has an answer to compare against (RA-080).
# {P} stands for the generated Sandbox project prefix — bzsandbox-<generation>.
# Writing the generation in here would make the file expire on the next rebuild
# of the project, and an expired manifest gets ignored rather than fixed.
# NO SECRETS. Names, images, networks, and whether a container is given
# credentials at all — never a value.
# name
# The operator itself. Deployed by infra/blueprint/sandbox-ops/sandbox-deploy.sh;
# restart policy is deliberately "no" — the deployer owns the lifecycle, and a
# container that comes back by itself hides a crash.
{P}-core-api-staging
{P}-api-gateway-staging
{P}-public-api-staging
{P}-developer-api
# BANZADMIN (Stage D, 2026-09-08) — the operator control plane, deployed by
# ./deploy.sh like the rest. Missing from this list until 2026-09-11, so every
# attestation since has failed on them. admin-api holds operator credentials
# (database, core internal key, admin session key, proof key, mail key) and
# reaches Resend; the console holds none and sits on the app plane only.
{P}-admin-api
{P}-admin-frontend
# The payer surface. No secret, no database, no Core credential — app plane only
# (ADR-052). It restarts on its own because it holds no financial authority and
# an outage is visible to every payer.
{P}-pay-frontend
# Sandbox data plane.
{P}-postgres-1
{P}-redis-1
# Public routing for the Sandbox. Not on the legacy network, so it cannot reach
# the older stack.
bzsbedge-sandbox-edge
# The webhook receiver the end-to-end harnesses deliver to. Isolated on its own
# network; holds nothing.
banzami-webhook-sink
# The older stack, still serving the website. Separate network, no Sandbox
# credentials, and no path from here into the Sandbox data plane.
# banzami-postgres-1 — REMOVED 2026-09-07. A disused PostgreSQL instance holding
# a database that shared the name of the real Sandbox one, on a network the
# Sandbox stack could not reach. Its only effect was that every migration check
# comparing the NAME passed for both. Container, data and compose definition gone.
banzami-redis-1
banzami-website-frontend-1
banzami-website-nginx-1
